How are the zodiac signs grouped by element?
What are the four elements in astrology?
a: The twelve zodiac signs are grouped into four elements of three signs each. Fire signs (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) are passionate, energetic, and action-oriented. Earth signs (Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn) are practical, grounded, and focused on material stability. Air signs (Gemini, Libra, Aquarius) are intellectual, communicative, and social. Water signs (Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces) are emotional, intuitive, and deeply feeling. Each element represents a fundamental energy type in astrological interpretation.

How do modalities work in astrology?
Which signs are cardinal, fixed, and mutable?
What is the difference between cardinal, fixed, and mutable signs?
a: The three modalities (also called quadruplicities) describe how each sign expresses its energy. Cardinal signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn) initiate action, start new cycles, and lead — they are the go-getters of the zodiac. Fixed signs (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius) stabilize, preserve, and build endurance — they are the sustainers who see things through. Mutable signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces) adapt, transform, and bridge transitions — they are the flexible communicators who handle change well. Each sign combines one element with one modality, creating twelve distinct archetypes.

q: What planets rule which zodiac signs?
Which planet rules Aries?

Which planet rules Scorpio?
Tell me about the ruling planets in astrology.
a: Each zodiac sign has a ruling planet that shares its essential nature. Mars rules Aries, Venus rules Taurus and Libra, Mercury rules Gemini and Virgo, the Moon rules Cancer, the Sun rules Leo, Pluto rules Scorpio, Jupiter rules Sagittarius, Saturn rules Capricorn, Uranus rules Aquarius, and Neptune rules Pisces. The ruling planet of a sign indicates the core motivations and behavioral style of that sign. In modern astrology, the outer planets (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto) govern the signs they were discovered during, while traditional rulerships still hold value in Hellenistic astrology.

What are the glyphs and symbols of the zodiac?
a: The zodiac signs follow the Sun's apparent path through the year, each spanning approximately 30 days. Aries (March 21-April 19) is the ram, Taurus (April 20-May 20) the bull, Gemini (May 21-June 20) the twins, Cancer (June 21-July 22) the crab, Leo (July 23-August 22) the lion, Virgo (August 23-September 22) the virgin, Libra (September 23-October 22) the scales, Scorpio (October 23-November 21) the scorpion, Sagittarius (November 22-December 21) the archer, Capricorn (December 22-January 19) the sea-goat, Aquarius (January 20-February 18) the water bearer, and Pisces (February 19-March 20) the fish. These dates can vary slightly by year due to the tropical zodiac's alignment with equinoxes and solstices.
